conformance.rationale: Root suite honestly rendered 1 pass / 7 fail in this pre-implementation browser — assertions genuinely falsifiable.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless-Chrome CDP run 2026-08-16 clicked the primary action; the honest unavailable/NotSupportedError state rendered; zero console errors and zero failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Fallback-branch asserts not confirmed on this page.

openQuestions.title: Capture the flag-enabled success path when a build with the algorithms is available
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 headless lacks these algorithms even behind flags; when a newer build is available to the harness, exercise the real success path (key generation, encrypt/decrypt or encapsulate/decapsulate roundtrip) and record the evidence.
